# Feeling Nifty

> > Feeling Nifty offers comprehensive acrylic painting courses and tutorials for all skill levels, from beginner-friendly techniques to advanced creative projects.

Feeling Nifty is a dedicated resource for painting enthusiasts providing step-by-step tutorials, painting ideas across multiple mediums (acrylic, watercolor, oil, gouache), and DIY art projects for all ages and abilities. The site features curated collections of painting inspiration organized by subject matter, season, and skill level.

## Key Topics

- acrylic painting
- beginner-friendly tutorials
- painting ideas
- canvas art
- watercolor painting
- painting techniques
- DIY art projects
- step-by-step painting
- painting supplies
- landscape painting
- seasonal painting projects
- easy painting ideas
- art inspiration
- home decor art

## Core & Getting Started

- [Easy Online Acrylic Painting Courses and Tutorials for all skill levels](https://feelingnifty.com): Feeling Nifty homepage: acrylic painting courses and free tutorials for all skill levels.
- [Paint Beautiful Acrylic Paintings with this Library of Step-By-Step Tutorials](https://feelingnifty.com/acrylic-painting): Library of step-by-step acrylic painting tutorials for beginners.
- [Acrylic Painting Supplies](https://feelingnifty.com/acrylic-painting/acrylic-painting-supplies): Complete beginner's guide to acrylic painting supplies and materials list.

## Beginner Painting Ideas

- [50+ Abstract Painting Ideas for Beginners: Creative DIY Techniques](https://feelingnifty.com/50-abstract-painting-ideas-for-beginners): 50+ DIY abstract painting ideas with techniques like acrylic pouring and watercolor.
- [50+ Easy-Peasy Landscape Painting Ideas For Beginners](https://feelingnifty.com/landscape-painting-ideas-for-beginners): 50+ beginner landscape painting ideas with techniques like atmospheric perspective.
- [51 Watercolor Painting Ideas to Spark Your Creativity](https://feelingnifty.com/51-watercolor-painting-ideas-beginners): 51 watercolor painting ideas for beginners covering landscapes and portraits.
